calculator_policy: Department-approved calculators only; non-approved devices are confiscated.
open_book_policy: One open book permitted only where the instructor has declared it in writing.
late_arrival_rule: Late arrivals are admitted up to 30 minutes after the start; after that the student must report to the proctor.
scheduling_limit_conflict_note: Three or more exams on one day is flagged as a scheduling warning.
notes: This is the single source for exam-day rules; the proctoring policy owns ID requirements.
